First Look: Aggressive Exterior Styling Of The 2027 Rivian R2 Performance

CA
By Chloe Adams Car Culture & Restomod Editor • via Car and Driver Wire
⚡ Visual Story
Source & Photography: Car and Driver Wire Dispatch Verified Editorial Asset
⚡ Executive Takeaways & Key Highlights
  • The Rivian R2 is a crucial vehicle for the young brand, slotting in below the pricey R1S as a competitor to the bestselling Tesla Model Y .
  • The boxy design helps the R2 feel incredibly spacious inside, with a truly palatial rear seat with tons of headroom and legroom.
  • Official reporting verified via Car and Driver news desk.
⚡ EDITORIAL TAKE • CHLOE ADAMS Car Culture & Restomod Editor

Heritage Preservation vs Modern Performance

Automotive passion is increasingly defined by the synthesis of analog soul and contemporary engineering. This coverage from Car and Driver illustrates how bespoke builders, private collectors, and restomod artists are preserving the golden eras of internal combustion while adopting carbon fiber composites and precision craftsmanship.

Big Picture: Auction hammer prices and enthusiast demand indicate sustained historical appreciation for rare, analog driver's vehicles.

The Rivian R2 is a crucial vehicle for the young brand, slotting in below the pricey R1S as a competitor to the bestselling Tesla Model Y .

📌 The Core Development

The boxy design helps the R2 feel incredibly spacious inside, with a truly palatial rear seat with tons of headroom and legroom.

The R2 Performance packs a dual-motor, all-wheel-drive powertrain capable of 656 horsepower and 609 pound-feet of torque.

🔍 Background & Sector Context

The punchy powertrain is enough for the R2 Performance to sprint to 60 mph in 3.5 seconds and complete the quarter-mile in 11.4 seconds at 126 mph.

Although the R2 is rapid, its taller ride height and compliant suspension lead to a bit of body roll in the corners, and its Pirelli Scorpion MS Elect tires posted 0.81 g on the skidpad.

📊 Industry & Real-World Impact

Cargo space is also impressive, with the R2 able to swallow 10 carry-on suitcases in our testing, while the rear window rolls down in case you need to fit longer items.

The EPA rates the R2 Performance at 330 miles of range, but on our 75-mph highway test, the Rivian managed to travel just 260 miles.
